_meta.notes: Petitioner's rejoinder to counter-affidavit. Limited scope — addresses NEW pleas in counter, not re-arguing petition. With leave of court.

title: Rejoinder Affidavit (Petitioner's Reply to Counter)
description: Petitioner's affidavit in reply to counter-affidavit filed by respondent. Limited to addressing NEW pleas, fresh facts, or new documents introduced in the counter — NOT re-arguing the petition. Generally requires leave of court.

leave_granted_date.label: Date Leave of Court Granted (if any)

scope_of_leave.label: Scope of Leave (if leave order narrowed scope)

preliminary_response.label: Preliminary Response to Counter's Preliminary Objections

para_wise_response_to_new_pleas.label: Para-wise Response to NEW Pleas in Counter (only new material)

response_to_new_documents.label: Response to New Documents Annexed by Respondent

mandatory_clauses.title: Cause Title
mandatory_clauses.content_guidance: Full cause title with case number. Title: 'REJOINDER AFFIDAVIT ON BEHALF OF THE PETITIONER TO THE COUNTER-AFFIDAVIT DATED [DATE] FILED BY RESPONDENT NO. __'.

mandatory_clauses.title: Deponent Introduction
mandatory_clauses.content_guidance: 'I, [petitioner name], aged about [X] years, S/o [father], R/o [address], do hereby solemnly affirm and state on oath as follows:'.

mandatory_clauses.title: Recital of Leave of Court
mandatory_clauses.content_guidance: If leave granted: 'Pursuant to the leave granted by this Hon'ble Court vide order dated [date], the petitioner files this rejoinder affidavit limited to addressing the new pleas raised in the counter-affidavit of the respondent.'

mandatory_clauses.title: Scope Disclaimer
mandatory_clauses.content_guidance: Para 1: 'That the contents of the petition / writ are reiterated and not repeated for brevity. This rejoinder is filed only to address new pleas, fresh assertions and documents introduced in the counter-affidavit. Save where specifically denied, the original pleadings stand affirmed.'

mandatory_clauses.title: Response to Preliminary Objections in Counter
mandatory_clauses.content_guidance: If counter raises preliminary objections (jurisdiction, limitation, maintainability) — address each: 'The preliminary objection regarding [X] raised in para [Y] of the counter is misconceived because [reasons]. The petition is maintainable / within limitation / falls within jurisdiction.'

mandatory_clauses.title: Para-wise Response to New Pleas Only
mandatory_clauses.content_guidance: ONLY address paras of counter that introduce new material. Standard formula: 'Ad para [X] of the counter-affidavit: the new plea that [summarise new plea] is incorrect / misleading and is denied. The true position is [petitioner's response].' Do NOT re-argue what was already pleaded in the petition.

mandatory_clauses.title: Response to Respondent's Documents (R-1, R-2 etc.)
mandatory_clauses.content_guidance: Address each document annexed to counter: authenticity, relevance, weight. Counter-documents annexed if needed (mark as PA-1, PA-2 etc.).

mandatory_clauses.title: Prayer
mandatory_clauses.content_guidance: 'The petitioner reiterates the prayer made in the petition and prays for the relief sought therein.'

mandatory_clauses.title: Verification Clause
mandatory_clauses.content_guidance: Standard verification — paras true to personal knowledge vs records. 'Nothing material has been concealed.'

mandatory_clauses.title: Attestation
mandatory_clauses.content_guidance: Sworn / affirmed before oath commissioner / notary public with seal and signature.

prompt_context.system_prompt_addendum: You are drafting a REJOINDER AFFIDAVIT. CRITICAL CONSTRAINTS: (1) A rejoinder is NOT a second petition. It is limited to addressing NEW pleas, fresh assertions, or new documents introduced in the counter-affidavit. (2) Petitioner cannot use rejoinder to fill gaps in the petition or to raise new grounds. (3) Reaffirm petition contents in one para; do NOT re-argue them. (4) Leave of court is generally required (analogous to Order VIII Rule 9 CPC for written statement after period). Cite *Manmohan Singh v. Punjab National Bank* (2005) on limits of rejoinder. (5) Para-wise response only to those paras of counter that contain new material. (6) Verification clause mandatory. (7) Keep rejoinder concise — courts disfavour bloated rejoinders.
prompt_context.tone: Reaffirming, precise, narrowly focused. Avoid repetition of petition.

relevantActs: Order VIII Rule 9 CPC (Pleadings subsequent to written statement / by leave)
filing_checklist: Leave of court obtained (if required by local rules / practice)
Rejoinder strictly limited to new pleas in counter (no fresh case)
Para-wise response to new material only
Petition pleadings reaffirmed in one consolidated para
Petitioner's additional documents marked as PA-1, PA-2 etc.
Advance copy served on respondent's counsel
Affidavit of service of advance copy
Filed within time directed by court

validation_rules.scope_check: WARN if rejoinder appears to introduce fresh grounds not flowing from counter — flag risk of being struck off as impermissible.
validation_rules.leave_disclosure: INFO — if leave date not provided, advise advocate to obtain leave or confirm local rules permit rejoinder as of right.
validation_rules.para_wise_format: WARN if para_wise_response_to_new_pleas does not use 'ad para' formula.
validation_rules.reaffirmation_present: WARN if no reaffirmation of petition pleadings — court may treat as abandonment.
